title: SSB Head Constable Non-GD PET / PST Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: SSB Head Constable (Non-GD) recruitment under the Constable to SI (Non-GD) Recruitment 2025 cycle.
qualification: As per the post-wise SSB Head Constable (Non-GD) recruitment notification.
ageLimit: As per the official SSB recruitment advertisement.

2. Open the Admit Card section

shortDescription: SSB Head Constable Non-GD PET/PST e-Admit Card 2026 has been released. PET/PST for the relevant Non-GD recruitment is being conducted from 08 August 2026 onwards.
content:
Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) has released the e-Admit Card for Constable to Sub-Inspector (Non-GD)-2025 PET/PST, covering the relevant Head Constable (Non-GD) posts.

The official SSB recruitment portal shows the e-Admit Card notice dated 07 August 2026. The PET/PST stage commenced from 08 August 2026, with individual candidates required to follow the date and venue printed on their e-Admit Card.

Candidates should download the call letter only from the official SSB recruitment portal and verify the reporting time, venue and physical-test instructions before appearing.
